title: Final Examination - Practical Generative AI for Business & Content Creation
description: This final examination assesses your understanding of AI content creation, image generation, video production, business applications and AI-powered career development. A minimum score of 70% is required to complete the course and qualify for certification.

questions.question: What is Generative AI primarily designed to do?

Create new content from user instructions
Increase internet speed
Replace every human profession

options: Written content
Images and videos

All of the above
